claims_boundary: This is an internal Worldshepherd alignment artifact, not NIST conformance, certification, approval, accreditation, or endorsement.

The current APNT evidence is synthetic software evidence and does not validate physical PNT source accuracy, shipboard integration, GPNTS, ASPN, pntOS, GNSS receivers, timing hardware, or operator performance.
The NIST public comment period is closed; no comment submission or NIST engagement is claimed.
Third-party, supplier, service-provider, and real-world PNT data dependencies remain unvalidated unless separately evidenced.
